info.description: REST API for CloudOrbit (AWS · Azure · GCP). Run 'Auth > Login' first; the token is stored in {{accessToken}} and inherited by every request. IDs are captured automatically by test scripts. Demo credentials (local only): admin@cloudorbit.dev / CloudOrbit!2026.
